registry: nodes[]: stable_id, canonical_title, title_zh, aliases, volume_id, kind, substantive, parent_ids, cross_memberships, source_ids, classification_codes, frontier
source: sources[]: id = source_id, title, url, source_group, kind, accessed_date, locator, support_summary, retrieval_status, reviewer_type, human_reviewer
identity_policy: Semantic stable IDs are never recomputed from title, order or hash. Multiple parents are placements of one node; classification labels are mappings, not additional copies.
classification_policy: Preserve the complete official two-digit MSC2020 and math.* arXiv acquisition. A mapping can target several concrete nodes; a generic math root is forbidden.
source_group_policy: A research paper and its mirrors form one group. A separately organized research event or an independently authored work is a separate evidence group; shared hosting is not identity and domain count is not the metric.

sampling_protocol.selection: For every nonempty primary-region plus hierarchy-depth stratum of nonfrontier substantive volume-one nodes, sort by SHA256(seed + NUL + stable_id), then take ceil(0.10 * stratum_size). Review all frontier nodes separately.
sampling_protocol.error_response: Record the original error, correct it without removing the failed sample, and review every node sharing the erroneous mapping or source-version pattern.

review_policy: All present mathematical/source audits are AI review of labels, source abstracts and event scopes, not human peer review and not proof verification. human_reviewer remains null.
capacity_policy: 600–1000 is future capacity planning, never a minimum to satisfy by padding.
